text: So the month of practices aimed at harmonizing the fourth chakra has come to an end. I hope that you practiced regularly and received fruits in the form of a healthier manifestation of your emotionality; perhaps relationships with close people improved (and maybe even with yourself). Perhaps even in terms of health something changed for the better… And now I suggest that you not lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you have strengthened a certain way of thinking, values, habits, psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all this, step by step discovering who you really are. Continued movement in this direction will, of course, give you deeper results.
